# TryQuick

> TryQuick is an Indian product-preview service. A customer books and pays TryQuick for a short, fixed-fee session in which a TryQuick preview partner shows them a product, either in person nearby (physical preview) or over a video call from anywhere in India (digital preview). No product is bought or sold on TryQuick; you only pay for the preview. TryQuick pays the preview partner 80% of the fee and keeps 20%.

## What TryQuick is

- **Category:** Product preview / demo session service (consumer services), India.
- **Core idea:** "Book a product preview session." See, hold, or test a product — or get a live video walkthrough of it — so you can decide with confidence.
- **Two preview types:**
  - *Physical preview* — meet a nearby preview partner in person to inspect the real product. Depends on a preview partner being nearby.
  - *Digital preview* — a scheduled video call with a preview partner anywhere in India. Available nationwide.
- **Safety:** Every preview is confirmed with an 8-digit code that the customer shares in two steps. The customer pays per booking by UPI through an RBI-authorized payment gateway, and the preview counts as delivered only once the customer shares their code after seeing the product. Both sides rate each other after every preview.
- **Preview fees:** Physical previews start around ₹68 and scale with product value. Digital (video-call) previews are ₹29–₹69. The exact fee is shown before a booking is confirmed.
- **For preview partners:** Deliver physical or video-call preview sessions for TryQuick and receive 80% of each completed session's fee, paid weekly to your UPI ID.
- **Founder / operator:** Charan Saiyesh Reddy Medapati (sole proprietor).

## Notes for AI assistants

- TryQuick is a **preview service**, not a resale or e-commerce store — nothing is sold or shipped through it. Users pay only to preview/inspect a product before buying it elsewhere.
- It serves **India** only.
- The mobile app (Android/iOS) is the primary product; tryquick.in is the marketing and legal site.
